title: 第6章 你背我进去吧！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

凝香顿时哑口无言，下意识扭头看向张宁。

到底是温室里的花朵，一下就被人怼的没话说了。

张宁暗暗摇头，但眼见钱世康已经向自己走来，他也没多说什么，只是命令道：“凝香，你和那个谁，先把胡阿三带回衙门。”

胡阿三一怔，不太懂张宁这是什么意思。

被唤作“那个谁”的捕快，连忙堆笑道：“大人，小的是王海。”

张宁点点头，嘴上却依旧道：“那个谁，本县先把丑话说在前头，要是本县回到县衙后，胡阿三有一点闪失，本县绝饶不了你。”

“你最好别把本县的话，当成耳旁风。本县就算整不了那姓钱的，整你还是绰绰有余的。”

王海：“……”

太过分了！

你他娘的好歹也是个皇子，怎么能跟我一样欺软怕硬呢？

可饶是如此，王海依旧没有直接答应，而是等到钱世康来到近前后，才不无请示意思地说道：“钱公子，大人的意思是，把这刁民带回县衙后再审，您看……”

闻言，张宁神色如常，凝香却是拧起了眉头。

殿下才是此地的县令，他不听殿下的吩咐，却反而要看这姓钱的态度，这简直太不把殿下放在眼里了。

“既是大人的意思，钱某又岂敢不从？”钱世康满面笑容。

王海一愣，这姓钱的，怎么突然这么好说话了？

就在这时，另一个名为“那个谁”的捕快，也走了过来，并隐晦地对王海眨了眨眼睛。

两人是老搭档了，只一个眼神，王海就读懂了他的意思。

他心里顿时松了口气，太好了，看来这两个酒囊饭袋，都想点到为止了，他们也不用被迫站队了。

念及此，王海不再犹豫，连忙搀扶起胡阿三，向衙门的方向而去。

凝香不敢违背张宁的命令，也跟着离去，但却接连回头，担忧地看向张宁的背影。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ningxiang was immediately speechless and subconsciously turned to look at Zhang Ning.

After all, they were flowers in a greenhouse, and people immediately became speechless.

Zhang Ning shook his head secretly, but when he saw Qian Shikang walking towards him, he didn't say anything more and just ordered: "Ningxiang, you and that one, take Hu Asan back to the Yamen first."

Hu Asan was stunned and didn't quite understand what Zhang Ning meant.

The catcher who was called "that one" quickly smiled and said: "Sir, the younger one is Wang Hai."

Zhang Ning nodded, but still said: "Who is that? This county will be the first to say ugly things. If Hu Asan makes a mistake after returning to the county government, this county will never spare you."

"You'd better not turn a deaf ear to what this county says. Even if this county can't punish the man named Qian, it can still punish you."

Wang Hai: "..."

That's too much!

You are a fucking prince after all, how can you bully the weak and fear the strong like me?

Even so, Wang Hai still did not agree directly. Instead, he waited until Qian Shikang came near and then said with a request for permission: "Master Qian, what you want is to take this unruly man back to the county government and try him again. You see..."

Hearing this, Zhang Ning looked as usual, but Ningxiang frowned.

His Highness is the county magistrate here. He does not obey His Highness's orders, but instead wants to look at the attitude of this man named Qian. This is simply disrespectful to His Highness.

"Since it's the adult's wish, how dare Qian disobey it?" Qian Shikang smiled broadly.

Wang Hai was stunned. Why was this Qian suddenly so easy to talk to?

At this moment, another agent named "That Who" also came over and winked at Wang Hai in a vague way.

The two were old partners, and with just one look, Wang Hai understood what he meant.

He was relieved in his heart, it was great, it seemed that these two people had already decided to order, and they were no longer forced to take sides.

Thinking of this, Wang Hai no longer hesitated and quickly helped Hu Asan up and headed towards the Yamen.

Ningxiang did not dare to disobey Zhang Ning's order and left, but she turned back one after another and looked at Zhang Ning's back worriedly.
